bull_case: H1 FY27 OCF $74.4B, 현금·현금성/marketable debt $56.6B에 더해 $42.8B marketable equity가 있어 외부자본 없이 운영·R&D를 감당할 능력이 매우 강하다. CP $25B 한도도 미사용이다.
bear_case: 총 $366B 미래약정, $279B 공급약정, AI cloud 보증/lease 및 $33.4B 부채는 하방에서 자본구조를 과거보다 복잡하게 만든다. AI 수요 급락 시 운전자본과 약정손실이 동시에 발생할 수 있다.
thesis: 재무생존능력은 강하지만 단순한 순현금 기업으로 보면 안 된다. 운영현금흐름과 유동성은 부채를 크게 상회하는 수준의 완충력을 제공하지만, 약정과 고객/파트너 지원의 명목규모가 매우 크므로 stress case에서는 계약의 취소가능성·보증범위를 함께 봐야 한다.

evidence.claim: As of July 26, 2026, NVIDIA had $56.586B of cash, cash equivalents and marketable debt securities plus $42.783B of marketable equity securities.
Total debt was $33.366B; only $1B was due within one year, and the $25B commercial-paper program had no amount outstanding.
H1 FY27 operating cash flow was $74.421B, and management stated existing liquidity was sufficient for operating requirements and future obligations for the foreseeable future.
Future commitments totaled $366B, including $279B of supply/capacity commitments, with additional customer/partner infrastructure support arrangements.
H1 FY27 SBC expense was $3.954B while NVIDIA repurchased 203M shares for $39.8B.

counterevidence: Commitment notional is several times current liquid fixed-income/cash balances.
Customer/partner guarantees can create contingent liabilities outside standard debt metrics.
Marketable equity holdings are volatile and should not be treated as cash-equivalent in a stress case.
A severe AI-capex downturn could combine revenue decline, inventory charges and supplier obligations.
unknowns: Cancelable/reschedulable portion of the $279B supply commitments under a severe downturn
Maximum loss from customer/partner infrastructure guarantees
Liquidity of strategic equity holdings during a correlated AI downturn

uncertainties.rationale: Liquidity and cash generation are exceptional despite new debt.
Large commitments create stress-case complexity even though current FCF is strong.
SBC is manageable but guarantees and long-dated commitments are substantial.

falsifiers: Operating cash flow collapses while supplier/customer commitments remain largely fixed.
Large guarantee or lease losses force external financing in a downturn.
Net share count begins rising materially despite strong cash generation.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: NVIDIA generates very large operating cash flow and has substantial liquidity; external capital is optional rather than required for survival today.
SBC is material but large repurchases offset it; no current evidence of persistent excessive net dilution.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Debt maturity profile and current cash generation make near-term solvency risk low; commitments are a downside risk but not currently a bankruptcy-level condition.

key_kpis.name: Liquidity / debt
key_kpis.threshold: Cash-generation capacity remains comfortably above near-term maturities

key_kpis.name: Commitment coverage
key_kpis.threshold: FCF and cancelability support outstanding commitments

subscores.rationale: Very strong liquidity, OCF and manageable near-term maturities.
Internal cash generation provides a strong buffer, tempered by very large commitments.
Net dilution is controlled, but contingent commitments and guarantees are material.
